problem.title: Running a business on WhatsApp means typing all day.
problem.body: Every day, the same work arrives: a three-minute voice note that needs a careful answer, a quotation you meant to send last night, a payment that's two weeks late, a Google review waiting for a reply, festival season coming with no Reels planned, and an English email to a supplier that you keep putting off.

before.title: Why “just using ChatGPT” gives generic answers
before.body: You've probably tried ChatGPT. The answers were polite, long and generic — because it didn't know your prices, your timings, your policies, or how you talk to customers.

after.title: What changes with this kit
after.body: You tell the AI about your business **once** — prices, timings, booking, payment methods, policies, tone, languages, your top FAQs, and the things you never say or promise. Then ten assistants do the drafting, the way you would. Anything they can't confirm is marked [CHECK].

steps.body: Prices, timings, booking, payment methods, policies, tone, languages, your top FAQs — and the things you never say or promise.

steps.title: Set up an assistant
steps.body: Copy its instructions, paste in your profile, and save it in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. No paid plan? Paste it into a new chat.

steps.title: Paste, check, send
steps.body: Paste a customer message and get a draft in the customer's language, short enough for WhatsApp, with one clear next step. Anything the assistant can't confirm is marked [CHECK] — it doesn't guess.

guardrailsIntro: You stay in charge: the assistant drafts, you check, you send.
guardrails: Never invents prices, dates, policies or facts — unknowns are marked **[CHECK]**
Flags refunds, discounts, compensation and risky complaints as **OWNER DECISION**
Reminds you never to paste Aadhaar, PAN, ID numbers, card or bank details
No legal, tax, medical or investment advice — it points you to your CA, lawyer or doctor
Quotes carry “GST as applicable — confirm rate and invoice details with your CA”; the kit never states GST rates or rules
Payment reminders are never threatening and use a [UPI/PAYMENT LINK] placeholder for your own link
Adds “have a fluent speaker check” to every Hindi, Hinglish or regional-language draft
Keeps hiring fair: no criteria based on caste, religion, gender, age or region

refund.title: 7-day no-questions refund
refund.body: Try the kit. Set up your assistants. If it isn't useful for your business, reply to your purchase email within 7 days of buying and we'll refund you in full. No forms, no questions.

faq.q: Do I need a paid AI plan?
faq.a: No. It works on free plans of ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini — paste the instructions into a new chat. Paid plans let you save each assistant so it's ready every time.
Your Business Profile and detailed instructions. The assistants know your prices, policies and tone, ask before guessing, and keep replies WhatsApp-short.

faq.q: Will it reply in Hindi or Hinglish?
faq.a: Yes, it matches the customer's language — English, Hindi or Hinglish — and can work in regional languages on request. For non-English replies, it adds an English meaning so you can check, and reminds you to have a fluent speaker check.

faq.q: Will it make up prices or promise things I don't offer?
faq.a: The assistants are instructed to stick to your profile and what you tell them, and to mark anything else as [CHECK]. AI can still make mistakes, so the kit includes a quick check to do before sending anything.

faq.q: Does it send messages for me?
faq.a: No. It drafts. You check and send from your own WhatsApp or email.
You choose what you paste. The kit tells you exactly what never to paste (Aadhaar, PAN, ID numbers, card or bank details, OTPs, health details with names) and how to remove names and numbers first.

faq.q: Can it do my GST calculations?
faq.a: No. Quotes include the line “GST as applicable — confirm rate and invoice details with your CA [CHECK]”. The kit never states GST rates or rules.

faq.q: I'm not technical. Can I set this up?
faq.a: If you can copy and paste on WhatsApp, you can set this up. The quick start takes about 10 minutes: 5 for your profile, 2 to set up the first assistant, 1 for a test message.

faq.q: What format is the kit in?
faq.a: Simple text files you can open on your phone or computer, plus a spreadsheet of prompts.

faq.q: What if it's not right for me?
faq.a: Reply to your purchase email within 7 days for a full refund. No questions asked.
